data.name: Bethara
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, the name Bethara is derived from the words bet (house) and yarah (God). It is translated to mean 'house of God' in English. In the Bible, Bethara is the name of a town in the land of Gad where King Saul consulted the witch of Endor (1 Samuel 28:3). The name has also been associated with the daughter of Jairus, the synagogue leader, who was raised from the dead by Jesus (Mark 5:35–43).
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing devotion and faith in God.
data.numerology_meaning: Bethara is a 9 Life Path Number, signifying a humanitarian and altruistic nature. Those with this number are natural born leaders, and have a strong desire to help and serve others.

in_hebrew.name: בֵּיתָארָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ביתארה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה העברית, מורכב משני מילים: בית שפירושו בית או מקום, וארה שפירושה אור או אש, ומשמעותו היא בית האור או בית האש, ויש הטוענים כי הוא נגזר מהשם העברי בית הר, שפירושו בית ההר, והוא מוזכר בתנ״ך כאתר קדוש

in_greek.name: Βηθαρα
in_greek.long_meaning: η Βηθαρα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα, αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: το σπίτι και το φως, και η σημασία του είναι το σπίτι του φωτός ή το σπίτι της φωτιάς, και κάποιοι υποστηρίζουν ότι προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα Βηθαρ, που σημαίνει το σπίτι του βουνού, και αναφέρεται στην Καινή Διαθήκη ως ιερό μέρος

in_latin.name: Bethara
in_latin.long_meaning: Bethara est nomen christianum quod origine habet in lingua hebraica, constat ex duabus vocibus: domus et lux, et significatio eius est domus luminis vel domus ignis, et quidam asserunt quod derivatur a nomine hebraico Bethar, quod significat domus montis, et in Novo Testamento mentionem habet ut locus sanctus

modern_usage.modern_context: Bethara is a term primarily used in the context of various spiritual and philosophical movements that draw inspiration from the Biblical figure Bethlehem, specifically the town of Bethara mentioned in the New Testament. The term 'Betharism' refers to the broader philosophical and spiritual movement, while the 'Bethara movement' and 'Bethara revival' specifically refer to contemporary groups that have adopted this ideology. Some of the core tenets of Betharism include a focus on community, simplicity, and reverence for the natural world. These ideas have found expression on various online platforms, with active communities on Reddit, Facebook, and Wikipedia, where discussions and debates around the meaning and significance of Betharism continue to evolve.
